name: lum-pet-cathedral
description: Lum, Wolverine, and Cutie ASCII scene forge with a compact in-chat MCP Apps wizard.

interface.longDescription: A three-step in-chat wizard for compact Lum, Wolverine, and Cutie ASCII/emoticon scenes. The widget sends completed scene instructions back to the host conversation, so the plugin itself does not require a provider API key.
defaultPrompt: @Lum Pet Cathedral open the scene wizard.
